origin.summary: Planning request for a generic first-class /storage route that serves temporary physical content through expiring, request-limited leases.

events.note: Created as a planning-only pending architect record. No storage implementation was authorized.
Expanded planning with route design, management APIs, feature inventory, deferred extensions, and a recommended v1 implementation scope.
Selected application.properties and a typed meshingress.storage group; a separate storage.properties file is not part of the design.

Resolved the planning architecture with internal tool ingestion and opaque-token retrieval. Secure management, remote ingestion, and other extended routes are deferred; no implementation was authorized.
User clarified that resolving an architect means accomplishing its intended design work. The earlier high-level route plan is insufficient without the code-level architecture.
Began the requested implementation-ready code architecture design without authorizing runtime implementation.

Completed the implementation-ready module/API, persistence/filesystem, lifecycle/concurrency, Spring route/configuration, and verification design. No runtime implementation was authorized or performed.
Resolved as a completed architecture design. Runtime implementation remains a separately authorized future execution slice.
User directed that completion requires source implementation and verification, not architecture documentation alone. Reopened to implement the approved v1 scope.
Implemented the producer API, typed configuration, filesystem/JDBC lifecycle, public capability retrieval, cleanup, and focused source tests for the accepted v1 scope.
Resolved only after source implementation and focused verification completed. Deferred source-tool opt-in and extended route capabilities remain out of scope.

The opaque-token blob lease design does not meet the clarified requirement: tools need session/request-scoped physical workspaces, a manifest file, and explicit file retrieval routes. Reopened to replace that contract in source code and verify it.
Replaced the blob lease with the meshingress-tool-api workspace contract, session/request filesystem layout, manifest publication, workspace metadata, explicit file routes, and cleanup.
Resolved after the source implementation and five focused workspace/controller tests passed in the full server reactor.
Re-ran the focused server reactor after adding tool ID to generated manifest metadata; all five workspace/controller tests still passed.
